title: Morning Brief — Wednesday, 11 November 2026
description: A new ban on NDIS provider kickbacks takes effect later this month, nine Queensland state schools are honoured at this year's Showcase Awards, and major construction ramps up on the Gold Coast's new Coomera Hospital. 한국어 방송도 이어집니다.
